formative_worksheets.title: The Sound and Letter Check
formative_worksheets.when_to_use: After Lesson 3, before Lesson 4. Quick mid-unit check (8 minutes).
formative_worksheets.purpose: Standalone formative check confirming phoneme awareness and letter-sound mapping before connected text reading.
formative_worksheets.student_learning_goal: I can hear sounds and match them to letters.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can hear sounds and match them to letters.
header.character_watermark: Sounder Sam with a clipboard in the top-right. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

prompts.visual_layout: One picture above a 3-cell sound box for the child to write a sound mark in each cell.

image_placeholders.description: A segment-the-picture layout for Grade 1 formative check, B&W line art. Picture of CAT above a 3-cell sound box. Cells are large enough for letters or marks.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q1_SEGMENT at Prompt 1: keywords name the picture and sound segment task.

prompts.answer_key: c-a-t (or 3 marks if not yet writing).

prompts.prompt: Match each letter to its sound.
prompts.visual_layout: Three letters on the left and three phoneme bubbles on the right with space for match lines.

image_placeholders.description: A letter-to-sound match layout for Grade 1 formative check, B&W line art. Left: letters c, m, s. Right: phoneme bubbles /c/, /m/, /s/. Connecting space for match lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q2_LETTER at Prompt 2: keywords name the letter-to-sound match task.

prompts.prompt: How are you feeling? Circle one.

image_placeholders.description: Three round face icons for Grade 1 formative check, B&W line art. Smile, neutral, thinking.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: FORM_Q3_FACES at Prompt 3: keywords name the feeling-faces self-rating visual.

formative_worksheets.teacher_notes: Administer between Lesson 3 and Lesson 4. Print one per child. Quick — should take 8 minutes.
